# Your fee schedule is not what you collect.

> Your fee schedule is not what you collect. Enter one month of production and contractual write-offs by carrier and see the effective reimbursement rate for every plan, which plans pay less than an hour of chair time costs you, and exactly what a fee increase would and would not collect. Free, private, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
